reviews.title: Once great..
reviews.text: They took free features I relied on put them behind a subscription. Things I used for free previously are no longer so. Sad to have to stop using this app, but I refuse to pay to change the breath frequency, that's absolutely ridiculous. Thanks for giving me a reason to redownload Calm :)
